methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Visual Adjective Anchoring
content: Problem: Vietnamese students naturally place adjectives after nouns (e.g., "thành phố lớn" = city big).

Solution: This week anchors the adjective strictly before the noun using strong visual pairings (a TALL building, a NOISY street). We teach the chunk "Article + Adjective + Noun" together so students feel the rhythm of the English structure rather than translating word-by-word.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Show a flashcard of a place/object. Student must add an adjective before it: "A car" → "A fast car."
S2 pull-out: Show a scene. Student makes a full sentence: "There is a tall building."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). Student A has information about a city. Student B has information about the countryside. They describe and compare.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W9: city, street, noisy, busy, quiet
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (city, street, noisy, busy, quiet) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: Adjective + Noun order
instructions: Grammar focus this week: Adjective + Noun order.
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Community & Routines — City Mission"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "Community & Routines — City Mission".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (city, street, noisy, busy, quiet usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.
